main_body: Round leaf canopy (about rows 1-29) on a straight brown trunk with root flare (rows 30-46)
top_band: At the centre column x=16 only row 2 is lighter (L=122, one row), followed by dark greens (L 56-76). Only the left column x=8 has a light cap at rows 2-5 (L 148-178), so no distinct top surface runs across the body.
evidence: The canopy is a rounded blob with dappled greens, and the trunk is a vertical column. No separate lighter horizontal band sits above a front face. In the middle column the canopy goes outline, one lighter row, then dark greens with no step or edge line. The trunk shows no top surface either. Strictly, no top band, front-edge line or eave shadow can be pointed to, so it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The outline is tinted (dark green by the leaves, dark brown by the trunk), and there are no 5x5 flat fills. But the candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. Leaf clumps are coarse single-pixel dither in a few greens. The trunk is a simple two-tone split with no grain, and the references have layered leaf clusters, branches and roots. Next to them it looks much thinner and flatter.
